sections.body_md: You usually build trust through direct dialogue, shared activity, and fast feedback. You tend to connect more deeply with people who enjoy discussing patterns, future possibilities, and meaning. In conflict you often default to harmony and emotional tone, so it helps to make your principles explicit. In close relationships and teamwork, you usually prefer flexibility, openness, and room to adapt.

sections.body_md: ENFP-A and ENFP-T share the same ENFP core. Within possibility, connection and creative momentum, the useful difference is how the two A/T styles handle confidence, pressure, feedback and self-correction, not which one is better.

content.quick_answer: ENFP-A and ENFP-T share the same ENFP core. Within possibility, connection and creative momentum, the useful difference is how the two A/T styles handle confidence, pressure, feedback and self-correction, not which one is better.

faq.answer: Around possibility, connection and creative momentum, the main difference is usually confidence style, stress response, feedback processing and self-correction, not a change in the ENFP core.
faq.question: What is the main ENFP-A vs ENFP-T difference?
faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: No. A/T describes style differences, not a ranking. ENFP situations can reward steadiness, caution or revision in different ways.
faq.question: Is ENFP-A better than ENFP-T?
faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: Look at your response to possibility, connection and creative momentum-related pressure, criticism, uncertainty and post-decision review rather than treating the label as a verdict.
faq.question: How can I tell whether I am ENFP-A or ENFP-T?
faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: No. It can support ENFP work-style reflection, but it should not replace skills, experience, values or context.

faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.
